name: Tofu, Mushroom & Tomato Bake with Caper-Parsley Gremolata over Rice
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, large dice tofu and return to the baking sheet.
Add tomatoes and mushrooms to the baking sheet with the tofu. Drizzle with oil, then season with Italian seasoning and salt; gently stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, stirring halfway through, until veggies are tender and tofu is golden, 12-15 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Juice lemon into the bowl with the parsley.
Peel and mince shallot. Add to the bowl.
Mince capers. Add to the bowl along with additional oil, garlic powder, and salt. Stir to combine the gremolata.
To serve, divide rice, tofu, and veggies between plates; top tofu with gremolata. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
